style.prompt: A live-action film still, 1930s pulp adventure, anamorphic widescreen, 16:9. Inside a torch-lit ancient stone temple chamber: carved sandstone walls, a low stone pedestal in the centre holding a small jade mask, dust in the air, two burning wall torches, a dark doorway at the back. In the foreground stands an adventurer, a man in his forties with a weathered tan, stubble, a battered brown fedora, a worn brown leather jacket over a khaki shirt, a leather satchel across his chest, facing the pedestal from a few steps away, seen from a fixed wide camera at eye height. Warm torchlight, deep shadows, film grain. No text.
